plain.li: The first of the year born to the herd: {PET_nameDef}, to {OTHER_nameDef}. I'm going down to the pens to look, and the work can wait.
[hatched] {PET_nameDef} hatched today, the first of the year in the herd. I'm going down to see it before the work takes me.

cheerful.li: The first of the year born to the herd, and it's a beauty, {PET_nameDef}! I'm off to the pens to grin at it like a fool.
[hatched] {PET_nameDef} is out of the egg, the first of the year! I'm off to the pens to see it.

plain.li: [body:beast] {PET_nameDef} is gray at the muzzle and slow to rise now. A good leader, and not much longer, I think.
[body:bird] {PET_nameDef} is ragged in the feather and slow off the roost now. A good leader, and not much longer, I think.
[body:other] {PET_nameDef} is slow in everything now. A good leader, and not much longer, I think.
